thread:
anya: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit delivery status? Need final quant recommendations, batching/caching suggestions, and clear ownership for regression alerts. Target: feature-complete by Mon 2024-04-15. Dependencies: eng-platform PR #412 (routing changes) and console metrics dashboard. Short updates please.

sam: Quant recs mostly done. For Llama-2 variants I recommend 4-bit PTQ with per-layer calibration for latency-sensitive routes. Benchmarks on A100: ~1.8x speedup, ~1.5% avg perplexity increase on eval set. Still validating on long-context samples.

kevin: Batching suggestions: auto-batch window at 8ms with max batch 16 looks best for 99th p95 latency tradeoffs. Also added a quick cache key suggestion — prefix-hash + route-id. Opened PR: https://git.redwood/eng/optimize-toolkit/pulls/29 (contains config + perf scripts). PTAL @sam @anya

olivia: Regression alerts: current pipeline raises too many false positives on casual prompts. Need a smaller, curated prompt set and stable eval scoring. Who owns assembling that ground-truth?

jin: I can take ownership of regression evals. Plan: curate 200 prompt pairs (focus on safety + hallucination + quality drift), run nightly evals, and wire results to the console alerts. Will start by Monday.

anya: Thanks @jin — please add the prompt list to the repo under /evals/optimize and tag @olivia for QA. @sam can you drop the final quant config (format we can consume) in the PR?

sam: Yup. Pushed config blob to PR 29. Example snippet:```json
{"model":"llama-2-7b","quant":"4bit","calibration":"per-layer","clip_norm":1.0}
```
Will add docs for the conversion script.

kevin: Noted on PR 29. I flagged a small change to the batching sampler — needs one more test. If tests pass, I can merge and trigger a canary.

olivia: Canary rollout question: do we have automatic fallback to 8-bit for any observed quality regression? Right now the fallback only checks latency.

kevin: Good catch — we should add quality gates. I can add a simple regression check that watches eval alert scores and flips `fallback_model: llm-8bit` if average quality drops >2 points over 3 runs. Want that as part of the canary?

anya: Yes, include quality gate for canary. Priority: avoid blast radius.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: optimize-toolkit v0.9.3 -> canary cohort A at 2024-04-10T18:00Z. Trigger condition: PR 29 merge + regression gate in place.

jin: For alerts, do we want both slack + console? I can wire both; slack channel should be #incidents or #eng-ml-alerts?

olivia: Route to #eng-ml-alerts first, escalate to #incidents if severity high. Also include a small summary in the console with top 3 failing prompts.

anya: Outstanding items: (1) @sam finalize quant docs + config (ETA Thu), (2) @kevin finish batching tests + add quality gate to canary (ETA Fri), (3) @jin curate prompt set + wire alerts (ETA Mon), (4) @olivia QA prompt set and confirm alert thresholds (ETA Mon). If anything slips, say so here. :thumbsup:

sam: On track for Thu.

kevin: Tests flaky but aiming for Fri. Will ping reviewers shortly.

jin: Starting curation today, will post PR draft by EOD Mon.

olivia: Will review PR and propose thresholds by Mon.

anya: Sweet — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short milestone doc in the project board and link back here. If anyone needs to reprioritize, ping me directly.

kevin: @anya quick Q — is eng-platform PR #412 blocking production routing changes or just optional?

anya: It's blocking: the routing header change is required for per-route quant selection. Eng-platform needs to merge first or we need a temporary routing shim.

kevin: Ok will coordinate with eng-platform. I'll open a tiny shim if needed.

sam: If eng-platform slips we can ship quant for dedicated clusters only as fallback. Not ideal but unblock.

anya: Good fallback. I'll add that to the board.

olivia: Thanks — good progress.
